stories.title: El veto del Supremo a la ‘ley de nietos’: “Voté en 2023, pero ahora me lo prohíben”

en.title: Supreme Court veto of the 'grandchildren law': "I voted in 2023, but now they forbid it"
en.summary: A descendant of a Catalan honorary consul in Uruguay expresses frustration that the Supreme Court has blocked legislation affecting external residents, claiming they are being treated as second-class citizens in a partisan dispute.

stories.title: El mundo en el que votará España: “La extrema derecha avanza, pero no es una partida decidida”

en.title: The world in which Spain will vote: "The far right advances, but it is not a decided match"
en.summary: Spain's November 29 elections occur amid global far-right expansion and widespread housing concerns affecting multiple countries beyond Spain's borders.

stories.title: La huelga general culmina la escalada de la conflictividad laboral: casi el doble de paros en ocho meses que en todo 2025

en.title: General strike caps escalation of labor conflict: nearly double strikes in eight months compared to all of 2025
en.summary: Labor disputes have increased significantly, with 1.37 million workdays lost through August compared to 383,000 in the same period last year, which unions attribute to the lack of a national collective bargaining agreement.

stories.title: La carta secreta que Pau Donés le escribió a Eugenia Silva durante su relación: «Libérate del miedo a vivir»

en.title: The secret letter Pau Donés wrote to Eugenia Silva during their relationship: "Free yourself from the fear of living"
en.summary: Pau Donés, the Barcelona-born leader of Jarabe de Palo who died from cancer in June 2020 at age 53, had written a personal letter to Eugenia Silva during their time together.

stories.title: Casi 13.000 afectados tras interrumpirse la circulación entre Barcelona y Madrid por el incendio de un tren en Zaragoza

en.title: Nearly 13,000 affected after traffic between Barcelona and Madrid is interrupted due to train fire in Zaragoza
en.summary: A fire on a high-speed train between Madrid and Barcelona caused railway traffic to be suspended, affecting nearly 13,000 passengers and 33 trains. The incident occurred near Ricla in Zaragoza when fire was detected in the train's rear cabin.

stories.title: De los cheques al diésel ruso: los 'regalos' de Trump para 'comprar' votos y salvar su segundo mandato

en.title: From checks to Russian diesel: Trump's 'gifts' to 'buy' votes and save his second term
en.summary: During the U.S. midterm election campaign, Democratic candidates attack Trump through advertising focused on issues including gasoline prices, the economy, and cost of living.

stories.title: La Comunidad de Madrid apuesta por las encinas y un mosaico de bosques, viñedos y pastos para regenerar la Sierra Oeste tras el incendio forestal

en.title: The Madrid Community bets on holm oaks and a mosaic of forests, vineyards and pastures to regenerate the Sierra Oeste after the forest fire
en.summary: The Madrid Community will invest nearly 25 million euros in a ten-year restoration plan for Sierra Oeste, prioritizing natural regeneration and creating fire-resistant forests.

stories.title: El Gobierno se aferra al Constitucional de Pumpido para salvar los 'votos de los nietos'

en.title: The Government clings to Pumpido's Constitutional Court to save the 'votes of grandchildren'
en.summary: The Supreme Court rejected a government appeal and upheld the suspension of voting rights for 163,000 recently naturalized citizens.

stories.title: El PP de Cádiz exige la dimisión del alcalde de Algeciras tras conocer una nueva denuncia de agresión sexual

en.title: PP in Cádiz demands resignation of Algeciras mayor following new sexual assault complaint
en.summary: Twelve of fifteen popular party councillors are calling for the mayor's removal after learning of a new assault allegation, with provincial leadership threatening disciplinary action against those who do not support the decision.

stories.title: Una segunda militante del PP denuncia al alcalde de Algeciras por abusar de ella sexualmente en su despacho

en.title: A second PP activist accuses Algeciras mayor of sexually abusing her in his office
en.summary: A second sexual abuse complaint against the Algeciras mayor has emerged from a party member, prompting calls for his resignation. The Supreme Court prosecutor is also reviewing a previous accusation related to incidents from 2020 and 2021.

stories.title: El incendio de un AVE corta durante cinco horas la línea de alta velocidad entre Barcelona y Madrid

en.title: A high-speed train fire cuts the Barcelona-Madrid rail line for five hours
en.summary: A fire in the rear cabin of a train carrying 283 passengers caused no injuries but disrupted service for approximately 13,000 passengers across 40 other trains.

stories.title: La emotiva carta de Pau Donés a Eugenia Silva que ve la luz seis años después de su muerte

en.title: The moving letter from Pau Donés to Eugenia Silva comes to light six years after his death
en.summary: A model has recovered unpublished words written by the Jarabe de Palo leader during their relationship, in which he reflected on fear, happiness, and life lessons.

stories.title: Alfonso Tolcheff (ING): "Estamos abiertos a cualquier compra que acelere el crecimiento en España"

en.title: Alfonso Tolcheff (ING): "We are open to any acquisition that accelerates growth in Spain"
en.summary: ING will launch its private banking services at the end of this month and begin initial corporate banking services in early 2027.

stories.title: Acciona lanza su división de 'data center' con un proyecto de 80 MW

en.title: Acciona launches its data center division with an 80 MW project
en.summary: Spanish multinational Acciona is seeking connection to Enel for its first major data center facility with over 500 million euros in planned investment, targeting a portfolio of 2 GW.

stories.title: PAI Partners prepara la venta de Áreas tras unos resultados récord

en.title: PAI Partners prepares the sale of Áreas following record results
en.summary: French fund PAI Partners and the management team of Spanish restaurant company Áreas are seeking an investment bank advisor to launch a process next year to find a new controlling shareholder.

stories.title: Juan Miguel Martínez Gabaldón (Galletas Gullón): "No buscamos un Messi, sino gente que quiera crecer"

en.title: Juan Miguel Martínez Gabaldón (Galletas Gullón): "We are not looking for a Messi, but people who want to grow"
en.summary: Galletas Gullón's leadership discusses its approach to recruitment and talent development.

stories.title: Alquilar casas y ganar hasta un 9%

en.title: Renting houses and earning up to 9%
en.summary: Toledo, Ciudad Real, Valencia, and Teruel are identified as the top provinces in Spain for purchasing property and subsequently renting it out for returns.
